changelog: THE MAP BAR IS REBUILT ON REAL PLATE ART AND NOW FITS THE SCREEN. Seed, HQ, Troops, Salvage, Deck, Cards and Medals are carved plates across the top, with How to Play and Menu on the right, and the row that used to sit along the bottom is gone. ASCENSION AND THE FIELD COMPASS now ride inside the ACT plate rather than claiming two plates of their own — they were what pushed the bar onto a second row on a deep ascension run. The bar measures itself against your window and only shrinks when the row would otherwise wrap, so on desktop all fourteen plates sit on one line at full size, and the salvage plate has room for its coin and four digits. PHONES ARE UNCHANGED: the one-row fit applies only where the desktop layout does, it undoes any shrink that would not actually save a row, and it re-measures once fonts have loaded.
